observations: Two photos show a black PlayStation console with a glossy/texture finish and a vertical stand position.
The console front face is visible but the exact model text/label is not readable in these photos.
No controller is clearly shown in either photo.
No ports, power button area, HDMI/USB ports, or back label/serial sticker are readable.
There is a watermark text overlay on the images ("POSTED ON JIJI" / "MCSTEVE"), but it does not provide verifiable specs.

claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console with one controller Pad
claims.evidence: Photos show a PS4-looking console, but the PS4 Pro model and the controller (and that there is exactly one) are not shown/readable.

risks.risk: Exact model may not be PS4 Pro (could be PS4 Slim/regular PS4), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the console model label/serial sticker (back/bottom) showing the exact model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-verified model (worst case: treat as a non-Pro PS4) until the label is shown.

risks.risk: Controller may be missing, not included, or not functional (drift/buttons).
risks.proof: Photo of the included controller(s) plus a short video showing it pairing and responding in a game/menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (worst case: no working controller included) until proof of controller inclusion/function.

risks.risk: Console may have faults (won’t power on, overheating, disc drive issues, HDMI/USB port faults).
risks.proof: Video of power-on to the PS4 home screen and a quick test: HDMI display works + controller works + (if disc) disc read test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested (worst case) until a successful boot/test is shown.

risks.risk: Storage size and condition (HDD/SSD capacity, health) affects value.
risks.proof: Photo of system storage screen (Settings > Storage) showing capacity, and/or a screenshot of system info.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lowest/unknown storage condition until storage capacity is confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the console model label/serial sticker (back or bottom) showing it is PS4 Pro.
Photo of the controller included (front/back) and confirm quantity (one controller).
Short video: power on to PS4 home screen with the controller connected.
If disc drive is used: video inserting a disc and showing it reads.
response.reason: The photos show a PS4-looking console but do not clearly confirm it is a PS4 Pro, do not show the controller, and do not show any working test—so a reliable worst-case price can’t be set without the missing decisive proof.
